prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1023; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with reported loss of consciousness for less than one minute at the scene, headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Initial neurological examination showed intact cranial nerves and no focal motor deficits, with mild balance impairment on tandem gait testing. A diagnosis of concussion without structural injury was made, and imaging was not indicated based on clinical decision rules.

Over the course of 28 visits, treatment followed a graduated approach. Early care emphasized cognitive and physical rest, with gradual reintroduction of reading, screen use, and light aerobic activity as symptoms allowed. Vestibular and oculomotor rehabilitation was added to address persistent dizziness and visual tracking difficulty, and cervical physical therapy was provided for associated neck pain and restricted range of motion. Symptom scores were tracked at each visit and showed steady improvement over the treatment period.

At discharge, the patient reported near-resolution of headache and dizziness, normal balance on examination, and a return to work with minor accommodations. Residual mild difficulty with prolonged concentration was noted. Ongoing self-management guidance and a return-to-activity plan were provided, with instructions to seek urgent care for any new or worsening neurological symptoms.
